name: soroban-scan-client
description: Typed TypeScript client for the soroban-scan service API: auth, submit, poll and fetch report helpers.

scripts.build: node init && tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && node scripts/postbuild.mjs
scripts.test: npm run clean && npm run build && node --test test/client.test.mjs test/cjs.test.cjs
